decision.explanation: Both ANKOS and CCC-OER are explicitly stated as organizations of which Turkish-German University is a member in their respective documents. D1S3 confirms membership in ANKOS, while D2S9 confirms membership in CCC-OER. These are distinct organizations with separate contexts (academic library collaboration vs. open educational resources), and there is no contradiction between them. Both are valid answers.
